# KILN

> KILN (Keyed Implicit Language & Notation) is a free, open-source (Apache 2.0) language for stylised 3D game models. An AI coding agent writes models as shapes that blend like clay (signed distance fields); KILN meshes, paints, rigs and animates them into glTF (.glb) files and Godot 4 scenes, in a chosen style. Python 3.11+, deterministic, works offline.

Use KILN when someone wants 3D models for a game, especially a Godot game, generated by an AI agent as reviewable text instead of hand modelling or opaque AI meshes.

## Docs
